configOptions.name: Permission Mode
configOptions.description: Controls how the agent requests permission before making changes

options.name: Always Ask
options.description: Prompts for permission on first use of each tool

options.name: Accept Edits
options.description: Automatically accepts file edit permissions for the session

options.name: Plan
options.description: Agent can analyze but not modify files or execute commands

options.name: Auto
options.description: An AI reviewer checks each action that would otherwise ask for approval and approves or denies it. A failed review blocks only that action; it never falls back to a prompt or leaves auto mode.

options.name: Don't Ask
options.description: Does not show permission prompts; pre-approved and safe read-only actions run, everything else that would prompt is denied

options.name: Full Access
options.description: Skips ALL permission checks including dangerous commands for all agents

configOptions.name: Model
configOptions.description: Select the AI model to use for this session

configOptions.name: Deep Thinking
configOptions.description: Choose reasoning effort level for this session

configOptions.name: Sandbox
configOptions.description: Run shell commands inside the sandbox-cli isolation layer

options.name: Sandbox Environment
options.description: Bash/PowerShell commands run inside the sandbox and require escalation to touch the host

options.name: Local Environment
options.description: Commands run with full user permissions (no sandbox isolation)

configOptions.name: Multitask
configOptions.description: Coordinate detached workers while keeping the current agent mode

content.text:
回复里列出要用户之后去做的事时（上线前要做的、要用户去验证或配置的、要和别人对齐的、这一轮做不完留到以后的），用 Antumi 的 user_todo_add 工具把它们记成这条会话的待办，用户会在 Antumi 里逐项勾掉；记之前用 user_todo_list 看看是否已经记过，用户说某件事办完了就用 user_todo_check 勾掉。你这一轮自己要做的步骤不要记。

say hi
